authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
rules: A FIELD child value is a TV key followed by a Value payload.
R2007+ Value begins with BL flags and then a BL data type.

ODA §20.4.99 says the type-specific variant is absent when bit 1 in Flags is set; this FIELD path suppresses the low two flag bits, consistent with LibreDWG master implementation but not treated as semantic evidence.
Data type 2 carries a BD double when its payload is present.
Data type 64 is an Object Id carried as an H soft pointer in the handle stream.
authority.scopeLimit: The exact handle join locates all 42 peer-selected AcObjProp roots among local raw-only shells, but their unexplained object-data suffixes keep them incomplete. Separately, 71 _text records have ACFD_FIELDTEXT_CHECKSUM children with flags=2/type=2; suppressing that CadValue payload per ODA leaves a 34-bit body suffix on each record. Preserve the whole record raw-only until a producer-backed schema identifies that suffix. LibreDWG JSON omits the child payload; this peer agreement does not resolve the physical body tail or establish semantic support. ACadSharp uses Flags&0x01 as its empty check and reads the 71 children as doubles; a temporary candidate parse matched its handle/value map 71/71. This is a conflicting implementation parse, not a schema decision. The ODA rule and current LibreDWG source still support suppression; see the reader-conflict receipt.
